terra.problem: Referring to the next card exposes the lesson format.
Zedekiah does ask a question, and the passage says Jeremiah was already imprisoned when Zedekiah spoke, not that he was locked up afterward.
The explanation guesses why Zedekiah was upset. Papa Dorin may not invent a reason, even when marked as a guess.
The passage does not say rebuilding comes later. It says houses, fields and vineyards will again be bought.
Saying Zedekiah did not want to hear the message presents his feeling as fact rather than as Papa Dorin's guess.
“Wrong field” uses the prohibited word “wrong” about the baker's answer.
The explanation is generic and repetitive, with little of Papa Dorin's personality.
The quote uses Jeremiah's first-person words before identifying him as the speaker.
The quote uses Jeremiah's first-person words without first identifying him as the speaker.
The line about visiting hours suggests a timing detail matched the LORD's word, but no visiting hours or time are given.
The explanation claims the deal cannot be denied later and guesses that this was the point of the witnesses. Neither claim is given in the passage.
The passage specifies Hanamel, the witnesses and all the Jews sitting in the courtyard, not everyone in the courtyard.
